title: Chapter 1177
text:
In the outer space of Planet Earth Ring, the two enormous Mech Legions, one black and one white, clashed like two mad dragons chasing after each other, constantly using their sharp claws to tear off pieces of flesh and scales from each other. Looking from afar, broken mechanical parts rained down like a storm. Every second, tens of thousands of casualties were inflicted.

The two Mechanical Deities were engaged in a fierce battle. Their enormous bodies were also extremely agile, and their heavy weapons clashed madly with powerful energy. Every time they clashed, they had the power to shatter planets, leaving terrifying wounds on each other's bodies. The efficiency of the nano repair was almost unable to keep up with the speed of the damage.

Every time the weapons clashed, a large number of mechanical troops that were too close would be shattered. Occasionally, a Mechanical Deity would be sent flying, and its enormous body would roll across the battlefield of the Mech Legion like an elephant rolling over a group of ants. Large amounts of sparks would explode, and countless mechanical troops would be directly crushed, regardless of friend or foe.

Countless turrets, psionic cannons, and dark energy rays appeared on every part of the body, throwing out countless light chains that lashed out crazily like dancing whips, wearing down the enemy's shields and triggering large areas of electric arcs.

As the two sides fought fiercely, the energy reaction in the battlefield increased steadily, creating a chain effect. Dark blue energy clouds appeared, extremely condensed and containing destructive power, forming an environment similar to the Psionic Seal Ring on the mother planet of the three Universal Civilizations.

The collision effect of highly condensed energy turned the battlefield into an extremely condensed energy field. The curvature of space was extremely unstable, and light was distorted here. The trajectory of the energy beams that shot out directly showed huge arcs and exaggerated angles.

Looking through this battlefield and looking at the stars in the sky, there seemed to be a layer of strange lenses. Strong scattered light appeared, and every ray of starlight had thousands of clones, outlining irregular patterns. At first glance, it looked like the sky was turning upside down, and the stars were shattered!

Clang!

The weapons clashed again, and a violent shockwave penetrated through the Mechanical Deity's body. Both of them retreated at the same time, increasing the distance between them.

Han Xiao glanced at the Celestial Punishment Edge in his hand. A few dents had appeared on the edge of the blade, and there were faint cracks.

Although both were Universal Treasures, Manison's Mechanic Emperor Trident was a model that had been modified many times. Its strength and toughness were much higher, and after clashing head-on too many times, the durability of the Celestial Punishment Edge decreased even faster.

However, the Celestial Punishment Edge's material was mixed with the ninth generation Black Star alloy that he had developed himself. Although its toughness was not as good as the Mecha Empire's self-made material, it carried some of Han Xiao's own characteristics, and its repair speed was slightly better. The durability of the Celestial Punishment Edge would slowly recover on its own.

Not much time had passed since Han Xiao had arrived with the fleet and launched an attack, to the two of them fighting so fiercely that the stars had lost their light. However, due to the extreme speed of the two of them, the number of collisions between them had already reached tens of thousands.

"You're really a miraculous person. When others think they've studied you thoroughly, you're always able to surprise them."

Manison's electronic eyes flashed. He also lowered his head to check the equipment on his body, and his emotions were rather complicated.

The energy conversion Universal Treasure armor made by imitating Black Star's Indestructible Body was already damaged everywhere, and the equipment itself was not perfect. Now, the power of Black Star's attacks was far greater than before, and he could even deal a few critical hits from time to time, which had already exceeded the endurance limit of this equipment.

Furthermore, every time Black Star used an explosive attack with the suffix of 'Getta Hadouken', he would harass him once in the private channel.

Manison had been counting in his heart. Until now, Black Star had used it a total of twenty-seven times. The moves were not the same, and different types of special attacks would be launched according to the trajectory of the floating energy gathering device. Even with his insight, he felt that this set of technology was unique and remarkable.

The damage to the Mechanical Deity was still manageable, and it could be recovered by absorbing mechanical soldiers. However, part of the damage penetrated the Mechanical Deity and affected the Lord's Avatar at the core, causing the Lord's Avatar's durability to decrease significantly. Manison's avatar did not have an Indestructible Body, so there was nothing he could do once it was destroyed.

"In your current state, you won't be able to fulfill your arrogant words. If you want to take the Spacetime Amber from me, why don't you show me your true strength?"

Han Xiao stroked the Celestial Punishment Edge's blade, quickly repairing the fine cracks, and grinned at old Manison.

"… We're Virtual Mechanics, but your fighting style is more like a Mechanical Pugilist … cough, Armed Mechanic. You've taken the wrong path, child," Manison said calmly.

"Isn't it fine as long as I can fight?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"You're right. There's no limit to strength. Being able to fight is more important than anything else … In that case, I'll let you see the true strength of a Virtual Mechanic."

Manison raised his arm, and the trident pointed at the light door of the secondary dimensional army box.

The next moment, the light door rippled, and a large group of special mechanical soldiers flew out. They were the soldiers that made him famous — the Indestructible Mecha Empire Army, special soldiers built with AI life forms as the core.

However, the most eye-catching ones were the three figures at the front of the Mecha Empire Army. They were releasing Beyond Grade A energy fluctuations without hiding anything.

Han Xiao looked over. These three figures were of different species, and they were a mixture of biological and mechanical components. He could tell at a glance that they were highly modified mechanical prosthetics.

Their bodies were covered with sophisticated machinery, and most of their skin was replaced with special alloys. Their faces were also replaced with metal masks, and it was impossible to see their original appearance. He could only see that their eyes had been modified into mechanical electronic eyes, flickering with a red light.

"So, these are the Felons …" Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

The Felons were old Manison's trump card. Using advanced biological modification and mechanical prosthetics technology, they transformed living Supers into powerful war weapons. Most of the organs in their bodies would be replaced.

This was especially so for the brain. Using mechanical technology to simulate biological tissues, it changed the thinking patterns of the nerve endings, changing the logic of the brain into a readable state.

It also used Virtual Technology to upload the consciousness of the transformed Supers to the quantum network, changing the nature of their consciousness and transforming their souls into artificial intelligence life forms. Like other artificial intelligences, they would be immune to all psychic spells and Esper Abilities, and they would listen to the commands of the controller. At the same time, they would retain the combat experience of the original body.

After the transformation, the Felons would retain most of their original abilities. However, because most of their biological tissues had been replaced, they would not be as strong as before. However, it was also because of this special transformation that they could enjoy part of the Mechanical Force bonus of the controller. Even if the conversion rate was not as good as normal mechanical soldiers, the actual combat strength they could unleash was much more terrifying than before!

"Transforming living Beyond Grade As? Aren't you afraid that the advanced civilizations and the development union will find trouble with you? "Although Han Xiao knew what was going on, he still pretended not to know and asked.

"Heh, they were all my spoils of war. I have the right to do whatever I want with them. Long before the association was established, I transformed them. As for the three Universal Civilizations, do you think they know nothing?" Manison's tone was calm.

All the Beyond Grade As that had fallen into Manison's hands had disappeared without a trace. The advanced civilizations and Beyond Grade A circles naturally had all kinds of guesses. Although they did not know about the existence of the Felons, there were also theories about the transformation of living bodies. The Mecha Empire's research madman had left a deep impression on them. It was hard to imagine that he would not dissect and study the Beyond Grade As that he had obtained.

After all, he did not have the Spacetime Amber like Black Star, which allowed him to open an exhibition hall extravagantly.

Manison basically did not use this trump card because every time he used it, the outsiders would obtain more information. He also rarely encountered enemies that required the use of the Felons.

Black Star was one of the very few opponents that he felt was worth using this trump card.

Buzz!

Mechanical Force lightning shot out and connected with three Felons of different sizes.

The eyes of the three Felons flashed red, and their auras skyrocketed.

Buzz buzz buzz!

The Felon in the middle trembled and also released Mechanical Force lightning, attracting the surrounding mechanical troops of the Mecha Empire to gather. Its body expanded rapidly, and a dazzling electric light enveloped the entire area!

At the next moment, five mechanical tails with distinct conical joints swung out fiercely, and an incomparably huge body soared into the air. It had a humanoid appearance, but it had beast-like organs. Its five long tails were like five long spears, and sharp claws extended from its fingers. Its appearance was extremely ferocious and violent.

The third Mechanical Deity had arrived!

Han Xiao's eyelids twitched.

This meant that the original body of this Felon was a Divine Throne Mechanic who had mastered [Fusion — Mechanical Deity]!

For a moment, he could not help but recall the first time he met the Mecha Empire. Old Manison had talked about the AI civilization and said that it was actually another Beyond Grade A Mechanic who was behind it. In the end, it became his collection. Perhaps this Felon was that Beyond Grade A Mechanic?

Boom!

While he was guessing, the thrusters on the back of this half-beast Mechanical Deity spat out, and the entire mechanical body accelerated, charging toward Han Xiao in the blink of an eye. Its sharp claws went straight for Han Xiao's head.

Han Xiao reacted immediately. The Celestial Punishment Edge turned and faced it head-on.

Clang!

The two mechanical bodies collided and shook at the same time. The half-beast Mechanical Deity was slightly weaker and was sent flying.

However, before Han Xiao could chase after it, he saw the half-beast Mechanical Deity suddenly swing its five tails and wrap around the Celestial Punishment Edge and the arm that was holding it. A huge force surged toward him, causing him to stagger!

On the other hand, not only did the opponent stop its momentum, it even closed the distance between them and immediately wrapped around Han Xiao. Its claws clawed madly, leaving rips on Han Xiao's armor.

At the same time, Manison took the opportunity and stabbed his halberd from the side. Han Xiao's movements were severely affected, and he could not block in time. His mechanical body was pierced through.

"Hiss …"

The intense pain from the Mechanical Force Neural Network made Han Xiao suck in a cold breath.

He could fight Manison head-on, but when faced with a two-versus-one situation, he couldn't do as he wished.

This Mechanical Felon was enhanced by Manison's Mechanical Force, and the Mechanical Deity it formed was extremely powerful. Even if its performance was not as good as his and the Mecha Empire's, the difference was not huge. Even if it was a one-on-one battle, he would have to put in a lot of effort to deal with it.

Han Xiao turned around and saw that the other two Felons did not attack his main body. Instead, they led the Mecha Empire's troops and charged into the army battlefield, tearing open a huge gap and attacking his Mech Legion.

One of these two Felons seemed to be a Pugilist, and the other seemed to be an Esper. They charged forward as if they were unstoppable, crushing the Apostle Weapons with their combat strength.

At this rate, in less than two hours, these two Felons would be able to dismantle all thirty or so Apostle Weapons under his command.

"What terrifying combat strength …" Han Xiao sighed from the bottom of his heart. The combat strength of the Felons had exceeded his expectations.

"Now do you understand how wrong it was to make me your enemy? I've reminded you before, but you've disappointed me time and time again! "

Manison twisted the trident, and psionic energy exploded, blowing Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity in half.

The half-beast Mechanical Deity immediately tore open the chest of the Mechanical Deity, digging out Han Xiao's main body and holding it in its hands. At the same time, it swung its five tails in all directions, dispersing Han Xiao's mechanical soldiers around to prevent them from recombining into the Mechanical Deity.

Han Xiao struggled but was unable to escape from the Mechanical Deity's hands. Although his main body was not afraid of being killed, it was difficult for him to shake the Mechanical Deity.

However, he was not in a hurry. He looked up at the huge Mechanical Deity and clicked his tongue.

"The weakness of this move is also very obvious. You have to bear the energy consumption of three Beyond Grade A weapons. How long can you last?"

"So what? Do I need that long to deal with you?"

Manison did not deny this weakness.

The Felons were modified by the mechanical gear and lost a lot of their cells that produced energy. In order for them to continue displaying the combat strength of a Beyond Grade A, they naturally needed a corresponding amount of energy. This part was borne by Manison.

Through the special energy conversion equipment of the Felon technology, Manison's Mechanical Force could be compatible with different classes of Felons. However, the conversion rate was also very harsh. If a Felon consumed 100 points of energy, he would have to consume 130 to 170 points. The load was very high, so his endurance would plummet.

Now that he had summoned three Felons, including himself, it was equivalent to him bearing the energy consumption of five to six Beyond Grade As. If not for the fact that Manison's energy regeneration was very fast, he would have been drained dry in a few seconds. However, even so, the balance of his energy regeneration was broken, and his energy was decreasing at a visible rate.

"You're right. If this was in the past, I would have had no choice but to run away. Unfortunately …"

Han Xiao shook his head. Not only did he not panic, he even wanted to laugh out loud.

Old Manison, I was waiting for you to use this move!

You think I only want to take your talents today?

My (Virtual Purification-Restore) has been waiting for a long time!

At this time, Manison raised his huge mechanical arm, wanting to take Han Xiao from the Mechanical Deity.

However, halfway through, his wrist was suddenly grabbed by the Mechanical Deity's sharp claws, unable to move an inch.

"Hmm?" Manison was stunned. He looked up and said in confusion, "What are you …"

Bang!

Without waiting for him to finish speaking, the five tails shot over and pierced into his face. Then, they abruptly tore outwards!

The Mechanical Deity was not prepared, and its head exploded into metal shards!

The entire Mechanical Deity flew backward and rolled twice before stopping, leaving a huge wound on its neck.

"What's going on?"

The sudden change stunned Manison, and a rare feeling of shock appeared in his heart.

Why did my Felons turn against me without warning?!
